seo.title: Weekly project summary
seo.seo_description: The Weekly project summary template turns your notes into a summary: progress, risks in a table, decisions to make and priorities. WorkStudio template.

blocks.role: Promesse de la fiche : ce que fait le gabarit « Synthèse hebdomadaire d'un projet », dit sans détour.

translation.headline: Weekly project summary.
translation.subheadline: The Weekly project summary template turns your notes into a summary: progress, risks in a table, decisions to make and priorities.

blocks.role: Réponse d'abord : ce que fait le gabarit, en trois lignes.

translation.title: The short answer.
translation.body:
The Weekly project summary template turns your notes into a summary: progress, risks in a table, decisions to make and priorities. A person approves it, and only their approval emails it, with the project name in the subject.

A workflow template is an automated sequence of tasks, provided as a starting point in WorkStudio and to be adapted to the business before it is deployed.

blocks.role: Les champs de départ du gabarit, tels que déclarés dans WorkStudio.

translation.title: What you provide.
translation.body:
Each starting field is pre-filled with an example value so a first run needs no typing, except email addresses and files.

  • The project. Project name.
  • The notes. Your loose notes from the week on the project.
  • The recipient. Email address to send the summary to.

blocks.role: Les étapes du flux : ce que fait chaque agent, où une personne intervient.

cards.title: Write the summary.
cards.text: An agent presents progress, risks (probability, impact, measure), decisions to make (who, by when) and priorities, with no invented figure or date.

cards.title: Get approval.
cards.text: A person reads the summary and approves or refuses it.

cards.title: Send by email.
cards.text: If approved, the summary goes to the recipient.

blocks.role: Ce qui s'adapte avant l'usage : le propre du gabarit, le commun, l'envoi.

cards.title: What to adapt here.
cards.text: The probability and impact of risks are the agent's estimate from your notes: read them before approving. Set up the mail server.

cards.title: What applies to all.
cards.text: The templates are written for a French small business. Taxes, currency, vocabulary and formats are adapted to your business and to Quebec before any use.

cards.title: A person approves before sending.
cards.text: The flow stops for a person's approval and sends the email only if they approve. The mail server (host, port, account, sender) is left to fill in.

blocks.role: Questions de la fiche : envoi, point propre au gabarit, adaptation au Québec.

items.question: Can it send an email without my approval?
items.answer: No. The flow stops for a person's approval and sends the email only if they approve. The mail server must be filled in.

items.question: Does the summary go out by itself on a schedule?
items.answer: No. The template runs when you start it and stops for a person's approval. A scheduled run is a trigger matter, to set up with you.

items.question: Does it suit Quebec as is?
items.answer: Not as is. The starter templates are written for a French small business and do not follow Quebec tax rules: taxes, formats and vocabulary are adapted to your business.

blocks.role: Appel à l'action : démonstration sur données fictives.

translation.title: See it at work.
translation.text: A demonstration on fictional data, to see what the template prepares and where a person stays in control.
